'''Antonio García-Bellido y García de Diego''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|ForMemRS]] (30 April 1936 – 10 November 2025) was a Spanish [[developmental biologist]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.elpais.com/articulo/portada/cientifico/iconoclasta/elpeputec/20060910elpepspor_1/Tes|title=ANTONIO GARCÍA BELLIDO: Un científico iconoclasta|newspaper=El País|date=2006-09-10}}</ref> His ideas and new approaches to the problem of development have been followed and pursued by many researchers worldwide.<ref>{{cite journal |pages=1277–90 |doi=10.1387/ijdb.072384ag |title=Ontogeny of an adventurous mind: The origin of Antonio Garcia-Bellidos contributions to developmental genetics |year=2009 |last1=Ghysen |first1=Alain |journal=The International Journal of Developmental Biology |volume=53 |pmid=19247947 |issue=8–9–10|doi-access=free }}</ref> García-Bellido was research professor at the [[Spanish National Research Council]] from 1974{{citation needed|date=November 2011}}, conducted research at the Center for Molecular Biology in Madrid for over 30 years, and supervised 22 PhD students.<ref>{{Cite Q|Q140845954}}</ref> He was elected as a Foreign Member of the [[Royal Society]] in 1986<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Antonio Garcia-Bellido FRS {{!}} Royal Society Fellow |url=https://royalsociety.org/people/antonio-garcia-bellido-11479/ |access-date=2026-06-03 |website=royalsociety.org |language=en}}</ref> and as an International Member of the [[National Academy of Sciences]] in 1987.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Antonio Garcia-Bellido – NAS |url=https://www.nasonline.org/directory-entry/antonio-garcia-bellido-cq2s1s/ |access-date=2026-06-03 |website=www.nasonline.org/ |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2012, he was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award from the [[Society for Developmental Biology]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=García-Bellido |url=https://www.sdbonline.org/sites/SDBe-news/Summer2012/garcia-bellido.html |access-date=2026-06-03 |website=www.sdbonline.org}}</ref>  He died on 10 November 2025, at the age of 89.<ref>{{cite news |title=Muere Antonio García-Bellido, descubridor de las fronteras invisibles dentro de los seres vivos |url=https://elpais.com/ciencia/2025-11-11/muere-antonio-garcia-bellido-descubridor-de-las-fronteras-invisibles-dentro-de-los-seres-vivos.html |access-date=11 November 2025 |publisher=El País |date=11 November 2025}}</ref>
